title: J.J. Watt to Fill in for Suspended Tony Romo in CBS Sports’ NFL Booth

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: J.J. Watt to Fill in for Suspended Tony Romo in CBS Sports’ NFL Booth
sources.description: A week after his arrest in Milwaukee on suspicion of operating a vehicle while intoxicated, Tony Romo has been placed on leave from his post at CBS Sports until further notice. CBS’ lead NFL color commentator since 2017, Romo is being benched six weeks before he and play-by-play veteran Jim Nantz were set to kick …
